apicultura.name: Beekeeping
apicultura.short_description: BeeTracker - Complete management and traceability system for honey producers, from hive to end consumer
apicultura.long_description: BeeTracker is a complete management and traceability application for honey producers. It helps beekeepers track honey from hive to end consumer, ensuring transparency and compliance with quality requirements. Transform a traditional apiary into a modern and transparent operation.

harvest_workflow.title: Complete Production Workflow
harvest_workflow.description: Step-by-step guided flow: Harvest → Extraction → Filtering → Decanting → Homogenization (optional) → Packaging → Storage → Shipping. Notes and documents can be added at each stage.

lot_operations.title: Advanced Lot Operations
lot_operations.description: Mix compatible lots, split large lots into smaller ones, complete parent-child traceability. Each lot maintains reference to the original lot.

packaging.title: Smart Packaging
packaging.description: Define jar sizes (275ml, 400ml, 950ml etc.), packaging sessions with automatic counting, unique serial code generation and printable QR labels.

quality.title: Quality Control & Analysis
quality.description: Record laboratory analyses (moisture, HMF, diastase), quality validation before shipping, automatic blocks for non-compliance.

warehouse.title: Warehouse Management (WMS)
warehouse.description: Warehouses with defined capacity, specific zones and positions (shelf, location), load and availability tracking, movements between positions with complete history.

iot_monitoring.title: IoT Hive Monitoring
iot_monitoring.description: HiveSense sensors (temperature, humidity), BeeCounter (bee counter), BeeAir (air quality). Problem detection, activity monitoring and real-time alerts via MQTT.

qr_scan.title: QR Code Scanning
qr_scan.description: Consumer scans the QR on the jar and sees: honey origin, type, harvest date, complete processing path and quality analyses.

geolocation.title: Scan Geolocation
geolocation.description: Product distribution map based on locations where codes are scanned (anonymous collection).

modules: IoT module for sensors (HiveSense, BeeCounter, BeeAir)
Packaging with serial codes and QR
CSV export for contacts and locations
benefits: Step-by-step guided workflow for process digitization
Increased consumer trust through QR and visible analyses
IoT monitoring - connected hives in real-time
Rapid problem detection through automatic alerts
Product distribution map through scan geolocation

food_traceability.name: Food Traceability
food_traceability.short_description: Event-sourcing system for complete food supply chain traceability - from farm to consumer
food_traceability.long_description: A robust food traceability platform based on event-sourcing, enabling forward and backward tracking of lots throughout the entire supply chain. Supports HACCP compliance, recall management, and audits. Suitable for producers, processors, logistics, and retail.

event_sourcing.title: Event-Sourcing Architecture
event_sourcing.description: Every operation is recorded as an immutable event: reception, transformation, split/merge, packaging, shipping. Complete and auditable history.

bidirectional_trace.title: Bidirectional Traceability
bidirectional_trace.description: Backward trace: 'Where does lot X come from?'. Forward trace: 'Where did lot X go?'. Impact analysis in seconds.

multi_actor.title: Multi-Actor Support
multi_actor.description: Producers, processors, logistics, retail - all on the same platform, with distinct roles and permissions.

compliance.title: Compliance & Audit
compliance.description: Complete 'who did what, when' journal, attached documents, HACCP/ISO report export.

recall.title: Recall Management
recall.description: Incident definition, automatic affected party list generation, real-time communications and confirmation tracking.

integration.title: ERP/WMS Integrations
integration.description: REST/GraphQL API, Webhooks, EDI import. Compatible with existing systems.

benefits: Increased trust from partners and consumers
